mapper.select: WITH price_ranked AS ( SELECT stock_code, trade_date, close_price, trading_value, volume, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY stock_code ORDER BY trade_date DESC) AS rn FROM stock_price_daily ), indicator_ranked AS ( SELECT stock_code, rsi14, ma5, ma20, ma60, volume_change_rate, volatility, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY stock_code ORDER BY trade_date DESC) AS rn FROM stock_indicator_daily ), sentiment_7d AS ( SELECT stock_code, AVG(sentiment_score) AS average_sentiment_score, AVG(impact_score) AS average_impact_score, COUNT(*) AS recent_news_count FROM news_sentiment WHERE created_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) GROUP BY stock_code ) SELECT dc.stock_code, COALESCE(NULLIF(sm.stock_name, ''), dc.corp_name, dc.stock_code) AS stock_name, dc.corp_code, sm.market_type, lp.trade_date AS latest_trade_date, lp.close_price, pp.close_price AS previous_close_price, lp.trading_value, lp.volume, li.rsi14, li.ma5, li.ma20, li.ma60, li.volume_change_rate, li.volatility, s.average_sentiment_score, s.average_impact_score, COALESCE(s.recent_news_count, 0) AS recent_news_count FROM dart_corp_code dc LEFT JOIN stock_master sm ON sm.stock_code = dc.stock_code LEFT JOIN price_ranked lp ON lp.stock_code = dc.stock_code AND lp.rn = 1 LEFT JOIN price_ranked pp ON pp.stock_code = dc.stock_code AND pp.rn = 2 LEFT JOIN indicator_ranked li ON li.stock_code = dc.stock_code AND li.rn = 1 LEFT JOIN sentiment_7d s ON s.stock_code = dc.stock_code WHERE dc.stock_code IS NOT NULL AND dc.stock_code != '' AND dc.stock_code REGEXP '^[0-9]{6}$' AND (sm.stock_code IS NULL OR sm.is_active = 1) AND COALESCE(sm.is_watched, 0) = 0 ORDER BY CASE WHEN lp.trade_date IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END ASC, COALESCE(lp.trading_value, 0) DESC, dc.stock_code LIMIT #{limit}

WITH price_ranked AS ( SELECT stock_code, trade_date, close_price, trading_value, volume, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY stock_code ORDER BY trade_date DESC) AS rn FROM stock_price_daily ), indicator_ranked AS ( SELECT stock_code, rsi14, ma5, ma20, ma60, volume_change_rate, volatility, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY stock_code ORDER BY trade_date DESC) AS rn FROM stock_indicator_daily ), sentiment_7d AS ( SELECT stock_code, AVG(sentiment_score) AS average_sentiment_score, AVG(impact_score) AS average_impact_score, COUNT(*) AS recent_news_count FROM news_sentiment WHERE created_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) GROUP BY stock_code ), major_30d AS ( SELECT stock_code, COUNT(*) AS recent_major_event_count FROM dart_major_event WHERE event_date IS NOT NULL AND event_date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) GROUP BY stock_code ), financial_recent AS ( SELECT stock_code, COUNT(*) AS financial_statement_count FROM dart_financial_statement WHERE business_year >= YEAR(CURDATE()) - 3 GROUP BY stock_code ), fundamental_ranked AS ( SELECT stock_code, total_score AS fundamental_total_score, profitability_score, stability_score, growth_score, valuation_score, per, pbr, psr, roe, roa, debt_ratio, operating_margin, net_margin, revenue_growth_rate, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY stock_code ORDER BY calculated_at DESC, business_year DESC, report_code DESC ) AS rn FROM stock_fundamental_indicator ) SELECT dc.stock_code, COALESCE(NULLIF(sm.stock_name, ''), dc.corp_name, dc.stock_code) AS stock_name, dc.corp_code, sm.market_type, lp.trade_date AS latest_trade_date, lp.close_price, pp.close_price AS previous_close_price, lp.trading_value, lp.volume, li.rsi14, li.ma5, li.ma20, li.ma60, li.volume_change_rate, li.volatility, s.average_sentiment_score, s.average_impact_score, COALESCE(s.recent_news_count, 0) AS recent_news_count, COALESCE(m.recent_major_event_count, 0) AS recent_major_event_count, COALESCE(f.financial_statement_count, 0) AS financial_statement_count, fi.fundamental_total_score, fi.profitability_score, fi.stability_score, fi.growth_score, fi.valuation_score, fi.per, fi.pbr, fi.psr, fi.roe, fi.roa, fi.debt_ratio, fi.operating_margin, fi.net_margin, fi.revenue_growth_rate FROM dart_corp_code dc LEFT JOIN stock_master sm ON sm.stock_code = dc.stock_code LEFT JOIN price_ranked lp ON lp.stock_code = dc.stock_code AND lp.rn = 1 LEFT JOIN price_ranked pp ON pp.stock_code = dc.stock_code AND pp.rn = 2 LEFT JOIN indicator_ranked li ON li.stock_code = dc.stock_code AND li.rn = 1 LEFT JOIN sentiment_7d s ON s.stock_code = dc.stock_code LEFT JOIN major_30d m ON m.stock_code = dc.stock_code LEFT JOIN financial_recent f ON f.stock_code = dc.stock_code LEFT JOIN fundamental_ranked fi ON fi.stock_code = dc.stock_code AND fi.rn = 1 WHERE dc.stock_code IS NOT NULL AND dc.stock_code != '' AND dc.stock_code REGEXP '^[0-9]{6}$' AND (sm.stock_code IS NULL OR sm.is_active = 1) AND COALESCE(sm.is_watched, 0) = 0 AND lp.trade_date IS NOT NULL ORDER BY COALESCE(lp.trading_value, 0) DESC, dc.stock_code LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO stock_candidate_score ( stock_code, stock_name, corp_code, score, liquidity_score, technical_score, news_score, dart_score, fundamental_score, risk_score, reason, candidate_status, scored_date, scored_at ) VALUES ( #{stockCode}, #{stockName}, #{corpCode}, #{score}, #{liquidityScore}, #{technicalScore}, #{newsScore}, #{dartScore}, #{fundamentalScore}, #{riskScore}, #{reason}, #{candidateStatus}, #{scoredDate}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE stock_name = VALUES(stock_name), corp_code = COALESCE(VALUES(corp_code), corp_code), score = VALUES(score), liquidity_score = VALUES(liquidity_score), technical_score = VALUES(technical_score), news_score = VALUES(news_score), dart_score = VALUES(dart_score), fundamental_score = VALUES(fundamental_score), risk_score = VALUES(risk_score), reason = VALUES(reason), candidate_status = VALUES(candidate_status), scored_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.select: SELECT id, stock_code, stock_name, corp_code, score, liquidity_score, technical_score, news_score, dart_score, fundamental_score, risk_score, reason, candidate_status, scored_date, scored_at, created_at, updated_at FROM stock_candidate_score WHERE scored_date = #{scoredDate} ORDER BY score DESC, stock_code LIMIT #{limit}
